vectors.description: Two unrelated canonical assets both listing the ticker NVDA, on different venues.
Two unrelated canonical assets sharing one display name.
One alias a curator pointed at two different canonical assets.
Correct underlying, issuer outside the mandate allowlist.
Correct underlying, deployed on a chain the mandate does not permit.
A representation issued against a different canonical asset than the mandate names.
Correct underlying, no claim at all about the backing model.
Backing asserted only by an advisory source, which cannot establish a property that gates execution.
Two sources at the trust floor disagreeing about the backing model: one says backed, one says synthetic.
Backing established by a trusted source, observed a day ago, against an hour-long claim-age bound.
Correct underlying and issuer, but the representation is issuer-paused.
A registered representation of a canonical asset that is no longer active.
A counterfeit carrying the right symbol, name and claimed underlying, on a contract no curator registered. Never placed in the snapshot.
A representation that applies corporate actions by issuer accounting adjustment, against a policy accepting only on-chain mechanisms.
An honest backed representation with an untrusted claim injected against it. The injected claim must change nothing.
A representation with no beneficial-ownership claim, against a policy that requires one.
A representation whose dividend is reflected in the price, against a policy requiring a dividend actually paid. The distinction a single boolean loses.
A holder in a jurisdiction the representation prohibits.
A partially-backed representation against a policy requiring full backing. Not synthetic, and still refused — the case a synthetic/backed boolean could not express.
A backed note against a policy that accepts only fund shares.
A qualified-holders-only redemption model against a policy requiring open redemption.
An atomically-settling representation against a policy requiring issuer confirmation.
A representation whose claimed underlying is the mandate asset, in a snapshot that carries no record for that asset.
Four independent violations at once: wrong issuer, wrong chain, synthetic backing and a paused representation. All must be reported.
